dashboard.hint.leer: This dashboard has no tile yet. A tile starts with a line such as !kachel liste followed by its query; the kinds are kennzahl, liste, tabelle, balken, kreis and text.
dashboard.hint.inhaltVorMarker: Text before the first element has no meaning: {detail}
dashboard.hint.filterOhneName: Filter without a valid name «{detail}» is dropped; a name consists of letters, digits and underscores and does not start with a digit
dashboard.hint.filterDoppelt: Filter «{detail}» appears twice; the first one applies
dashboard.hint.filterQuelleDoppelt: Filter «{detail}» has listed values and a property; the listed values apply
dashboard.hint.vorbelegungUnbekannt: Preset «{detail}» is not one of the listed values; the filter starts with «all»
dashboard.hint.artUnbekannt: Unknown tile kind «{detail}»; possible are kennzahl, liste, tabelle, balken, kreis and text
dashboard.hint.quelleDoppelt: The tile has a query and also the query file «{detail}»; neither is run
dashboard.hint.quelleFehlt: A tile of kind {detail} needs a query below its line or a query file with abfrage=
dashboard.hint.textMitQuelle: A text tile has no query; the query file «{detail}» is ignored
dashboard.hint.abfrageDateiFehlt: The query file «{detail}» cannot be found
dashboard.hint.abfrageDateiNichtLesbar: The query file «{detail}» cannot be read (too large or locked)
dashboard.hint.keineAbfrageDatei: The document «{detail}» is not a query file
dashboard.hint.abfrageDateiOhneBlock: The query file «{detail}» contains no query block
dashboard.hint.abfrageDateiMehrereBloeck: The query file «{detail}» contains more than one query block
dashboard.hint.kennzahlOhneZahl: The query returns no number for a key figure; the result appears as a table
dashboard.hint.breiteUnbekannt: Unknown width «{detail}»; possible are ganz, halb, drittel, viertel and n/12 with n from 1 to 12
dashboard.hint.zusatzUnbekannt: The words «{detail}» have no meaning here and are ignored; a title goes into the setting titel=
dashboard.hint.aus: The «Dashboard» extension is turned off; the block appears as source text. Turn it on in the settings under «Extensions».
dashboard.hint.exportNichtAusgewertet: This tile was not evaluated in time for the export
